name: His daughter
message: Dad, you taught us to be kind before being clever. Every time I see someone help a stranger, I think of you. We miss you beyond words.

name: A niece
message: Uncle Vincent always had time for us. He never made you feel small. He listened — really listened — and you left feeling lighter.

name: A childhood friend
message: From primary school to now, you were the same Vincent — steady, funny, and true. My brother, my friend. Rest well.

name: University roommate
message: We survived exams, empty pockets, and too many late nights together. You carried that same loyalty into everything you did in life.

name: Fellow ophthalmologist
message: Vincent was the colleague you wanted on a difficult case — calm, precise, and always willing to teach. The profession has lost a fine doctor.

name: Hospital nursing team
message: He knew every nurse by name and never walked past without a greeting. He made our ward feel human. We grieve with his family.

name: The Okello family
message: You gave my mother her sight back, and sat with us afterwards with such kindness. We are forever grateful.

name: Former patient
message: I was terrified going into surgery. Dr. Nyagucha held my hand and said, 'We will take care of you.' He did. God rest his soul.
